questions.question:
In the following question a statement has been given with highlighted text. You are required to replace the text with correct phrase given in the options.

His__** intriguing mastery**__ of the English language allowed him to write eloquently.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

__
 
• The phrase **"intriguing mastery"** means a captivating or fascinating skill or proficiency in something, especially when it arouses curiosity or interest. (मोहक कौशल)

 
 
• **Example: **His** intriguing mastery** of chess made him an opponent to be feared in every tournament.
 
 
 
• **"Captivating expertise" **refers to a skill or knowledge that is so interesting and enchanting that it captures the attention and admiration of others. (मोहक विशेषज्ञता)
 
 
• **Example: **Her **captivating expertise** in storytelling kept the audience engaged for hours.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct replacement for** "intriguing mastery"** is **"captivating expertise".**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wellness known skill** (स्वास्थ्यप्रद ज्ञात कौशल): Refers to a skill that is known for contributing to well-being or health.

 
 
• **Example:** Yoga is a wellness known skill that promotes both physical and mental health.
 
 
 
• **Least known talent** (कम ज्ञात प्रतिभा): Refers to a talent that is not widely recognized or known.
 
 
• **Example: **His least known talent is his ability to play the violin masterfully.
 
 
 
• **Master** (मास्टर): A person who has complete control of or skilled proficiency in a particular area.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a master of five different languages.

questions.question:

The manager noticed a __discrepancy__ between the two audit reports.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'Major difference."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Discrepancy'** itself implies a notable of significant difference between the two audit reports.

 
 
• **Example**- Discrepancies in the firm's financial statements led to an investigations.
 
 
 
• **'Major difference'** it emphasizes the significance of the two variation observed by the manager, indicating that it is substantial enough to warrant attention.
 
 
• **Example**- This is the third major difference between the two sets of meetings.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **'Major difference'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The rest of the options are incorrect because;
 
• **'Deliberate mistake'**- The sentence does not imply any intent behind the difference observed by the manager. It simply states that a difference was noticed.
 
• **'Selfish interest' **- The manager noticing a discrepancy between audit reports does not necessarily relate to selfish interests. it's more about identifying inconsistences or error on the reports.
 
• **'Great similarity**'- The sentence states that the manager noticed a discrepancy, indicating a lack of similarity or agreement between the two audit reports.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

In yesterday’s fire accident, __her feets are__ burnt badly.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"feet"** is the plural form of **"foot,"** which refers to **the lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.** (पैर)

 
 
• **Example:** She dipped her **feet** in the cool water to relax.
 
 
 
• **"Were"** is the past tense plural form of the verb** "to be,"** used with plural subjects. (थे)
 
 
• **Example:** They** were** happy with their results.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct phrase is** "her feet were" **to indicate that both feet were affected in the past incident.

Therefore, the correct sentence is **"In yesterday’s fire accident, her feet __were burnt badly."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: her feet was** (उसके पैर था): Incorrect because "was" is singular and "feet" is plural.

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: Her feet was cold. Correct: Her feet were cold.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: her foots were** (उसके पांव थे): Incorrect because "foots" is not the correct plural form of "foot."
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: Her foots were aching. Correct: Her feet were aching.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: No substitution** (कोई प्रतिस्थापन नहीं): Incorrect because the original phrase "her feets are" is grammatically incorrect.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: Her feets are cold. Correct: Her feet were cold.
